source.scope: Tracked Rust files and non-ignored working-tree additions; deleted working-tree paths are omitted.

files.measurement: Read the NUL-delimited output from git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard directly in Bash without sorting it, retain existing *.rs paths, then count physical lines with LC_ALL=C awk using NR. Path order does not affect the per-file gate, and the pipeline does not require non-portable NUL sorting.
files.p90_method: For this receipt only, sort the collected line counts ascending and select the nearest rank: ceil(0.90 * 143), rank 129.

limit.decision: The requested 300-line gate sits above the measured 293-line maximum and acts as a tripwire. scripts/check-rust-source-size.sh reads Git's path stream without sorting, rejects the identifier string too_many_lines anywhere in Rust source, and reports each violating tracked or non-ignored new Rust file exactly once.

functions.measurement: Run Clippy across locked all-target and all-feature builds. The configured threshold 100 passed. Copy clippy.toml to a temporary CLIPPY_CONF_DIR, change only the threshold to 98, and rerun the same command; exactly one (99/98) diagnostic establishes the maximum.

limit.decision: The requested 100-line Clippy threshold remains above the measured 99-line maximum. Cargo.toml sets too_many_lines to deny, scripts/check-policy.sh enforces that exact setting, and CI runs Clippy across all targets and features. The source-size gate rejects the identifier string anywhere in Rust source, so source-level lint overrides fail before Clippy runs.
